name.text: Analyzing Monotonicity and Boundedness of a Sequence

questiontext.text:
Consider the sequence, \(\displaystyle {@quest_seq@}_{n=1}^{\infty}\)

Complete the following statements about the properties of this sequence.

  1. Monotonicity: The sequence is [[input:ans1]]
    [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

  2. Boundedness: The sequence is [[input:ans2]]
    [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

A monotonic sequence is a sequence of numbers that either always increases or always decreases, but not both.

A sequence or a set of numbers is said to be bounded above if there exists a number such that all the elements in the sequence are less than or equal to that number, and vice versa for bounded below


Looking at this sequence \( \displaystyle {@quest_seq@}_{n=1}^{\infty}= {@a1@},{@a2@},{@a3@},{@a4@}, \cdots \)

We can conclude that it is {@ta1@}

and is {@ta2@}
